channel.title: Wildcard Watch: PHP Group
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving PHP Group, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: PHP: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
PHP: Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update PHP to the fixed version for your release line (for example 8.2.35, 8.3.36 or 8.4.27).

PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution. CISA lists 1 more flaw in PHP as exploited on the same day (CVE-2026-109619).

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619
